vars.group: Education · School conditions (Civil Rights Data Collection)
vars.label: Students chronically absent (%)
vars.ref: US Department of Education, Civil Rights Data Collection 2017-18 and 2021-22, public schools, via the Urban Institute's Education Data Portal; pooled by municipio
vars.definition: Students absent 15 or more school days in the year, for any reason (excused or not), as a share of the students enrolled. Public schools that answered the Civil Rights Data Collection, placed in a municipio by the NCES school directory; the share is pooled over the schools that report both figures, never an average of school shares. The year is the school year that starts in it (2021 = 2021-22); 2019-20 was not collected.

vars.group: Education · School conditions (Civil Rights Data Collection)
vars.label: Students per school counselor
vars.ref: US Department of Education, Civil Rights Data Collection 2017-18 and 2021-22, public schools, via the Urban Institute's Education Data Portal; pooled by municipio
vars.definition: Students enrolled for each full-time school counselor (full-time equivalents). Puerto Rico's staff items are missing in 2017-18. Public schools that answered the Civil Rights Data Collection, placed in a municipio by the NCES school directory; the share is pooled over the schools that report both figures, never an average of school shares. The year is the school year that starts in it (2021 = 2021-22); 2019-20 was not collected.
